title: ModeTable
description: Scalars that turn the single damage code path into Arcade, Simulation or Extreme behaviour.

beam_break_scale.description: Multiplier on beam failure strain and detachable break impulses (higher = tougher).

cabin_intrusion_total_loss_m.description: Cabin intrusion that forces a total loss regardless of health, m.

component_damage_scale.description: Multiplier on component health loss per metre of intrusion.

engine_kill_on_total_loss.description: If true the engine is killed when the vehicle becomes a total loss.

global_health_from_intrusion.description: If true global health is derived from structural intrusion (in addition to components).

impulse_to_lattice_scale.description: Multiplier from rigid-body contact impulse to impulse injected into the lattice.

plasticity_scale.description: Multiplier on plastic flow (how much permanent set a given over-yield strain produces).

police_damage_scale.description:
Multiplier on the contact impulses that reach the damage model of AI police cars.
Arcade uses 2.0 (police wreck about twice as fast); omitted = 1.0 (full damage).

racer_damage_scale.description:
Multiplier on the contact impulses that reach the damage model of *racer* cars (the
player's racer and AI racers; AI racers also get `ai_racer_damage_mult`). Traffic and
player-driven police always take 1.0, AI police `police_damage_scale`. Arcade uses
0.25, which leaves racers about 20 % of the damage (the lattice takes the first part
of a hit elastically); omitted = 1.0.

total_loss_health.description: Global health (0..1) below which the vehicle is a total loss.

wheel_detach_scale.description:
Wheel-detach susceptibility: the wheel mount failure threshold is divided by this
(lower = wheels stay on longer).

DamageMode.description: Damage mode. Every mode runs the same code path with a different [`crate::ModeTable`].

oneOf.description:
Forgiving: the Simulation table with the player's racer taking about 20 % of the damage
(`ModeTable::racer_damage_scale`), AI racers twice that (`ai_racer_damage_mult`), AI
police twice full damage (`police_damage_scale`) and traffic full damage.
Punishing but survivable; one hard hit degrades, several end the car.
Real-world-ish; one hard hit at speed is a total loss (the pre-0.4 Simulation table).
